config.presets.description: Preset(s) to lint with when no `qlinter.json` is found in the workspace. Defaults to `recommended`; set it to an empty array to run no rules at all. A workspace `qlinter.json` always takes precedence over this setting. Individual rules are configured in a `qlinter.json`, not here — see the [rule reference](https://github.com/MuellerConstantin/qlinter/blob/main/packages/core/docs/rules.md).
